name: Expected Sine/Cosine Encoding
definition: Computes the expected value of sin(x) and cos(x) for a Gaussian variable x ~ N(mean, var). Uses the identity E[sin(x)] = sin(mean) * exp(-var/2) and E[cos(x)] = cos(mean) * exp(-var/2). The code implements this by passing mean and var to a function that likely applies this transformation, though the internal logic of `expected_sin` is not shown, the input structure is defined.
